query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `reference_citations` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `citing_id` int NOT NULL,
  `cited_id` int NOT NULL,
  `citation_type` enum('direct','indirect','methodological','theoretical','data','critique','support','comparison') DEFAULT 'direct',
  `context` text,
  `page_number` varchar(50),
  `notes` text,
  `weight` int DEFAULT 1,
  `verified` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `verified_by` int,
  `verified_at` timestamp,
  `added_by` int,
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `reference_citations_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `unique_reference_citation` UNIQUE(`citing_id`, `cited_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_citing` FOREIGN KEY (`citing_id`) REFERENCES `bibliography_entries`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_cited` FOREIGN KEY (`cited_id`) REFERENCES `bibliography_entries`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  INDEX `reference_citations_citing_idx` (`citing_id`),
  INDEX `reference_citations_cited_idx` (`cited_id`),
  INDEX `reference_citations_type_idx` (`citation_type`)
);
